snippet.title: pgs demo trailer 2k
snippet.description:
The Eastern Han is collapsing, and the realm has fallen into chaos.

Warlords rise across the land. Liu Bei commands little land and few soldiers, yet refuses to abandon the ideal he has chosen to follow. From the oath sworn in the Peach Garden, like-minded heroes gradually gather around him, enduring defeat, exile, and hardship as they continue their long struggle to restore the Han.
